name: Tony Tony.Chopper
title:
Call out your allies and go on the attack!
A strong in numbers {Animal} type deck.
desc: Tony Tony.Chopper supports characters with the {Animal} type in this offensive red/green deck. Use cards that play {Animal} types directly from your deck, paired with the Leader effect to strengthen 3 {Animal} Characters, bringing attack power with the swarm.

cards.name: Tony Tony.Chopper
cards.text: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Give up to 3 of your {Animal} or {Drum Kingdom} type Characters up to 1 rested DON!! card each.

cards.name: Nami
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Straw Hat Crew} type card other than [Nami] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Dr.Kureha
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 4 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 [Tony Tony.Chopper] or {Drum Kingdom} type card other than [Dr.Kureha] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Tony Tony.Chopper
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 2 or less.

cards.name: Tony Tony.Chopper
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)[DON!! x2] [When Attacking] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −3000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Tony Tony.Chopper
cards.text: [On Play] Play up to 1 {Animal} type Character card with 3000 power or less from your hand.

cards.name: Tony Tony.Chopper
cards.text: [Your Turn] [On Play]/[When Attacking] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck and play up to 1 {Animal} type Character card with 4000 power or less rested. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Hiking Bear
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Up to 1 of your {Animal} type Characters other than this Character gains +1000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Lapins
cards.text: [DON!! x2] [When Attacking] If your Leader has the {Drum Kingdom} type, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 4000 power or less.

cards.name: Dr.Hiriluk
cards.text: [Activate: Main] You may rest this Character: If your Leader is [Tony Tony.Chopper], all of your [Tony Tony.Chopper] Characters gain +2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Trafalgar Law
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On Play] You may return 1 Character to your hand: Play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 3 or less from your hand.

cards.name: Silvers Rayleigh
cards.text: [On Play] Select up to 2 of your opponent's Characters, and give 1 Character −3000 power and the other −2000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 3000 power or less.

cards.name: Just Shut Up and Come with Us!!!!
cards.name_en: Just Shut Up and Come with Us!!!!
cards.text: [Counter] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck and play up to 1 {Animal} type Character card with a cost of 3 or less. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Radical Beam!!
cards.text: [Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this battle. Then, if you have 2 or less Life cards, that card gains an additional +2000 power.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +1000 power during this turn.
